name: tpl-existence-1-goal
task: Pick up the key, then reach the goal.

texts: Reach the goal after acquiring the key.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u2
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key) -> u1
(u0, at_goal&has_key) -> u2
(u1, at_goal) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_goal&has_key, u1) -> 1
(u0, at_goal&has_key, u2) -> 12
